question: For the year 2012, which top 10 evaluation groups have the largest subplot acres when considering only the condition with the largest subplot acres within each group? Please include the evaluation group, evaluation type, condition status code, evaluation description, state code, macroplot acres, and subplot acres.
sql:
-- Final query with proper casting and evaluation_group_description as the evaluation group identifier
WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_type,
    c.condition_status_code,
    c.state_code,
    SUM(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot) AS total_subplot_acres,
    SUM(COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0)) AS total_macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c 
    ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    AND p.state_code = c.state_code
    AND p.inventory_year = c.inventory_year
    AND p.survey_unit_code = c.survey_unit_code
    AND p.county_code = c.county_code
    AND p.phase_2_plot_number = c.phase_2_plot_number
  WHERE p.inventory_year = 2012
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_type, c.condition_status_code, c.state_code
),
best_per_group AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.evaluation_group ORDER BY ca.total_subplot_acres DESC) AS rn
  FROM condition_acres ca
),
eval_desc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_type,
    evaluation_description,
    evaluation_group_description
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
  WHERE inventory_year = 2012
)
SELECT 
  ed.evaluation_group_description AS evaluation_group,
  bg.evaluation_type,
  CAST(bg.condition_status_code AS STRING) AS condition_status_code,
  ed.evaluation_description,
  CAST(bg.state_code AS STRING) AS state_code,
  bg.total_macroplot_acres,
  bg.total_subplot_acres
FROM best_per_group bg
JOIN eval_desc ed 
  ON bg.evaluation_group = ed.evaluation_group
  AND bg.evaluation_type = ed.evaluation_type
WHERE bg.rn = 1
ORDER BY bg.total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10
